description: Buff-state outline presets: emissive color, scale and fade times applied to character/weapon or shikigami materials when status bits turn on/off.

ID.simple: Outline preset key (BREAK_FALL, INVINCIBLE, SUPER_ARMOR, HYPER_ARMOR, LIMITLESS, COUNTER).
ID.technical: FName row key resolved through Shikigami_FindMaterialOutlineRow over MaterialOutlineDataTables (+0x810, retail 0x14126A9E0). AGameCharacter::Tick derives six buff-board bits from its status controller and requests AddOutline/RemoveOutline by these exact names; AGameShikigami uses an invincibility flag to request INVINCIBLE. The shared finder rejects NAME_None and returns the first matching row; missing rows silently do nothing.

OutlineEmissiveColor.technical: FVector converted to FLinearColor (X,Y,Z used as RGB, alpha default) and passed to MaterialController->StartOutlineEmissiveColor(Color, Duration); for characters the identical color/scale pair is also applied to WeaponController. Values can exceed 1.0 (e.g. LIMITLESS Z=2.6), i.e. HDR emissive values are not clamped in this code. Export colors: green BREAK_FALL, blue-grey INVINCIBLE, amber SUPER_ARMOR, red HYPER_ARMOR.

OutlineScale.technical: Float passed to MaterialController->StartOutlineScale(Scale, Duration) (and WeaponController for characters). Export values 3.0 for BREAK_FALL/INVINCIBLE and 4.0 for the armor/counter/limitless rows; the animator drives the material's OutlineScale parameter over the same fade-in duration as the color.

FadeInTime.technical: Float seconds used as the Duration argument of both StartOutlineEmissiveColor and StartOutlineScale. Export values are 0 for BREAK_FALL/INVINCIBLE/COUNTER and 0.05 for the armor/limitless rows. Zero means an immediate change through the animators.

FadeOutTime.simple: Duration of the outline reset when the buff turns off.
FadeOutTime.technical: Float seconds passed to the owner's ResetOutline(FadeOutTime) (retail 0x14127DD30/0x14127DE...) on the RemoveOutline branch. Row color and scale are not read on removal; all six exported rows use FadeOutTime=0.

notes: MaterialOutlineDataTables is manager slot +0x810; the loader name is registered at GameDataTableManager.cpp:432 and resolved at line 259. All six exported rows are reachable from the character's six buff bits; only INVINCIBLE is requested by the available shikigami code.

The material controllers cache material parameters named OutlineEmissiveColor and OutlineScale and animate them (GameCharacterMaterialController.cpp:159-171; GameShikigamiMaterialController.cpp:26-38). This establishes the destination parameters, but the row-to-parameter binding is made only through the Start*/ResetOutline calls above.
This is a separate table from MaterialRimDataTable (+0x820), which has no identified row consumer in the available source.

usages.detail: Shikigami_FindMaterialOutlineRow walks MaterialOutlineDataTables and returns the first row with the requested name (retail 0x14126A9E0).
Character tick maps six status buff bits to LIMITLESS/COUNTER/BREAK_FALL/SUPER_ARMOR/HYPER_ARMOR/INVINCIBLE row requests.
Adds the row's color/scale over FadeInTime to both character and weapon material controllers; removal calls ResetOutline with FadeOutTime.
Shikigami add/remove INVINCIBLE outline using the same four fields on the shikigami material controller.
